name: Saudi tourism and cultural videos
note: Starter suite. Prompts describe generic scenes only: no brand, no named real person, no claim about a specific property. Extend to 20+ prompts with the client-facing team before using results for a decision.
negative: morphing, warped geometry, distorted faces or hands, flicker, on-screen text, watermark, cartoon look

prompts.prompt: Wide aerial drone shot gliding toward the sandstone rock formations of a desert valley at dawn, long shadows across the sand, a single 4x4 leaving a dust trail, epic travel film.

Slow crane-down in front of a monumental tomb facade carved into a sandstone cliff, warm morning light raking across the carved columns, two visitors standing small at the base for scale, heritage documentary.
Underwater tracking shot over a coral reef in clear turquoise water, sun rays through the surface, a snorkeller above, calm natural motion, coastal tourism film.
Handheld cinematic walk through a narrow alley of a historic coastal old town with coral-stone houses and carved wooden rawashin balconies, late afternoon light, a shopkeeper arranging brass lamps.
Wide pan across terraced green mountains with stone houses on the ridge and low clouds drifting through the valley, cool morning light, southern highlands travel film.
Tracking shot alongside a line of camels walking over red dunes at golden hour, long shadows, a guide in traditional dress leading, fine sand blown by the wind, slow motion.
Medium wide shot of men in white thobes performing a traditional sword dance in a line in a mud-brick courtyard, drums in the foreground, festive flags, warm evening light, cultural festival film.
Slow dolly-in toward a restored mud-brick palace with triangular windows and crenellated walls at blue hour, lanterns lit, palm trees, heritage district travel film.
